input.target: powerhouse repository docs -> v6.2.2-dev.74 (159 sources)

handoff.workDone: Recorded 159 markdown docs from the powerhouse repository as bai/source documents pinned to v6.2.2-dev.74: 152 created, 7 updated in place (the 6 Book of Powerhouse parts and one skill source). The 24 docs whose text changed since v6.2.2-dev.47 were ingested twice — baseline first, then current — so each source's own history carries the upstream diff. Provenance on every source: url = blob at the tag, publishedAt = the file's last upstream commit, method = sha256 + git tag. 85 sources hold claims and are EXTRACTED; 74 have no notes yet and stay INBOX as visible backlog. Archived material (packages/reactor/docs/archive, COMMANDS-LEGACY, bench fixtures, .claude, docs/superpowers) was excluded as not reflecting current code.

Read every changed diff and the three new files, then wrote 57 knowledge notes: 27 on the auth scope (policy model, staged flags, positional judgment, denied operations, groups, reads, DCB append condition, evaluateActions/useCanExecute, shipped vs remaining stages), 21 on infrastructure (Switchboard identity resolution and credential re-check, Renown source selection, Connect runtime config and enforcement flags, the Harbor image set, compose channels, release pipeline, monorepo build prerequisites, headless Privy sign-in) and 9 on the reactor surface (executeBatch's ordering-only guarantee, the layered processor host module, attachment byte progress, outbox scope ordering and its adjacent defects, the generateMock subpath, CLI reference stamps). Every note carries a DERIVED_FROM edge per cited source with the section named in its reason, at least two typed links, and CORE_IDEA membership in one or more MoCs. 0% skip rate on the changed docs: every substantive change is either a new note or a correction to an existing one.

Brought the 61 pre-existing notes that stood on the changed docs up to date. 52 whose claims the diffs did not touch were re-verified against the new text and stamped version v6.2.2-dev.74. Five were corrected in place with a dated paragraph: the processor-host-module cast that is no longer needed, the "atomic" executeBatch wording, the useAttachmentUpload status/stage rename, the generateMock import path, and the six-table group-permission claim that the code retired in migration 003 while the Academy page still documents it. Three that mislead as wholes were superseded and archived: the ghcr.io Docker-images note, the inverted IProcessorHostModule layering, and the executeBatch note whose failure-propagation claim is false. Two SUPERSEDES edges were downgraded to RELATES_TO where the older note was corrected rather than replaced.

Verified by read-back rather than by dispatch: every source's stored sha256 matches the file at v6.2.2-dev.74, every note reached CANONICAL through submit + approve by a different actor, and every archived note reports status ARCHIVED with its successor edge in place. Both CONTRADICTS edges opened tensions automatically; the reducer-RBAC-versus-auth-scope pair was dissolved with the boundary written into both notes, and the positional-revocation-versus-discarded-re-evaluation-writes pair was left OPEN as a live defect with the limitation recorded in both notes. Health check re-run and the report rewritten. Honest gaps: 74 sources remain INBOX with no notes, and 143 pre-existing notes tagged v6.2.2-dev.47 could not be attributed to any repository file, so their version stamps were left untouched rather than bumped.

input.target: extract the 64 unmined repository sources -> v6.2.2-dev.74

handoff.workDone: Extracted the 64 repository sources that the v6.2.2-dev.74 sync had recorded but never mined. Read every file at the pinned tag and wrote 89 knowledge notes across nine batches: the reactor's own design docs (25 — storage triple, write cache and keyframes, collection sync, ordinal frames of reference, the two documented sync gaps, the TLA+ proof's scope, the attachment store/transport pair and the hash-first commitments), specs and ADRs (14), reactor-api and reactor-browser packages (10), package READMEs (13), Academy reference and release notes (9), Academy Build pages (11), apps and CLIs (7). Every note carries a DERIVED_FROM edge naming the section it came from, at least two typed links, and MoC membership. Claim and skip counts are recorded per file from a real reading, not inferred: 116 claims against 152 conscious skips, a 57% skip rate that is the honest finding for a corpus containing tutorial narration, cloud-vendor walkthroughs and a 49k chronological changelog.

Linked the 89 new notes into the existing graph rather than beside it: 513 edges, every one carrying a reason and a confidence. Where a document disagreed with the code at the tag, the disagreement became the note — five CONTRADICTS edges, each of which the graph-indexer turned into a tension. Verified against source before asserting drift: the relational-DB processor spec's onStrands/InternalTransmitterUpdate/PowerhouseDB API is absent from the tree, the drive-analytics README still describes strands, the Academy's Renown SDK page imports a RenownUserProvider the package does not export, the environment-setup guide is built on a ph service command missing from phCliCommandNames, and the document-model README still installs @acaldas/document-model-libs.

Closed out every tension this pass opened. Dissolved two where both claims hold in different layers and wrote the boundary into the notes: lazy drive sync versus whole-drive reads (conditional on an unshipped opt-in flag, with the ADR's own audit prerequisite recorded on the drive-app note), and client-side last-write-wins versus the reactor's operational reshuffle (a lost local intention is not a corrupted log). Resolved two in favour of the code: the relational base class does not discover migrations (the generated template overrides initAndUpgrade), corrected in place rather than archived; and @renown/sdk exports no React provider. Left one open as a live defect — the batch aggregator emitting an incomplete batch with no notification — with the contradiction written into the flow note. Also promoted the 12 sources whose honest yield was zero from INBOX to EXTRACTED, since each now carries an extraction record with its reasoning.

Verified by read-back: all 159 repository sources are EXTRACTED, every one carrying a method matching git:v6.2.2-dev.74; 71 now hold a real extraction record with per-file claim and skip counts. Every new note reached CANONICAL through submit plus approval by a different actor, and none has fewer than two outgoing links. Health re-run and the report rewritten. Honest gaps that remain and are recorded there: 88 sources still hold claims attributed by content match with no extraction record of their own, 276 notes still carry the v6.2.2-dev.47 stamp (143 of them unattributable to any repository file), 2,648 pre-1.0.36 edges still carry no reason, and 8 agent-skill sources still hold duplicate claim entries pending a package publish that ships REMOVE_EXTRACTED_CLAIM.
